scope: Fresh compilation of eleven sources, including eight prerequisite modules, and transitive axiom audits of every explicit public theorem/lemma. For an admissible high pair word, actual two-step high return is equivalent to second-step no overflow, original exterior at least 14, and LocalAllowed at every actual first-successor position with its determined carry sum. For a canonically represented high starting integer, its first and second positive outputs are both nonpalindromic exactly when some adjacent source sum is at least 28, equivalently some actual first-successor pair coefficient is at least 10. This safety equivalence needs no high-return assumption. Positive widths including width one and overlapping reflected positions are included. No assertion is made about starting-state or later-output safety, decimal Lychrel existence, or the 196 conjecture; independent mathematical review remains separate.
theorem_enumeration: All explicit public theorem/lemma declarations in the eleven sources, with namespaces resolved and a theorem-token census to reject omissions. Declaration-generating macro/elaborator command tokens are rejected; private helper dependencies are audited transitively.
